slides.title: The Break Is the Record
slides.body: Notes on building a verification pipeline, first pointed at the world, then at itself.
slides.source: post title; body = subtitle with the clause 'without quite meaning to' cut for length
slides.exec_caption: The label becomes permission: if the note says verified, build on it.

slides.label: The seed claim
slides.headline: Anthropic suspended two of its own models under U.S. export controls, then restored them weeks later.
slides.body: Dates, an agency, a resolution. Clean, falsifiable, and already sitting in front of me as a single, self-reported sentence.
slides.coda: That last part is the whole essay.
slides.source: post §intro, paras 1-2 (author's wording, 'of this year' and model names cut). Fact: anthropic.com/news/fable-mythos-access (directive Jun 12, 2026) and anthropic.com/news/redeploying-fable-5 (controls lifted Jun 30; access restored per Jul 1 update), read 2026-11-10

slides.label: Mechanism and reason
slides.definition: after a reported jailbreak that got the model to identify software vulnerabilities.
slides.body: A claim that states the mechanism while omitting the reason is technically true in the way an alibi can be technically true.
slides.source: post §What the sources actually said, para 2 (body verbatim). Fact: anthropic.com/news/redeploying-fable-5, read 2026-11-10: 'Amazon researchers had found a method of bypassing Fable 5's safeguards: prompting it so that it identified a number of software vulnerabilities'

slides.label: One verb, two outcomes
list: Fable 5: back to users globally, with an improved safety classifier
Mythos 5: back to a set of U.S. organizations, under a separate government approval
slides.body: Completeness failures are the ones that pass every fact-check and still leave you with a wrong picture.
slides.source: post §What the sources actually said, paras 3-4. Fact: anthropic.com/news/redeploying-fable-5, read 2026-11-10: Fable 5 'to users globally on the Claude Platform, Claude.ai, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork'; 'we trained an improved safety classifier'; Mythos 5 restored 'for a set of US organizations, following the US government's approval on June 26'. Post's 'vetted' and 'every surface' dropped: the primary source says neither

slides.label: Then it found itself
slides.headline: The ledger gained a line that read clean and closed open questions.
slides.body: It said a named act and regulatory section had been confirmed by outside analysis. Read directly, that analysis framed the legal question as unresolved.
slides.coda: The addition to the ledger had rounded an open question up to a settled fact.
slides.source: post §Then it found itself, paras 2 and 4 (coda verbatim). The pipeline's own history: the post is the authority

slides.label: Verify before you build on it
slides.headline: That has to include the pipeline's own output.
slides.body: An unverified claim sitting in a note already marked verified is wearing the credibility of everything that checked out before it.
slides.source: post §Then it found itself, paras 3 and 5 (author's wording, compressed)

slides.label: The tool taught me something too
slides.headline: A note with two duplicate keys in its frontmatter becomes invisible to structured queries.
slides.body: Silently, with no error raised anywhere. It looks completely normal to a human.
slides.coda: I had reasoned about the tool without testing it. The correction cost nothing but five minutes and a little pride.
slides.source: post §The tool taught me something too, paras 3-4 (author's wording; coda line 1 compresses 'I reasoned confidently about a system's behavior without testing it')

slides.label: What's left standing
slides.headline: I corrected it, logged the correction, and left the original wrong version visible.
slides.body: Quietly fixing it and moving on would have erased the only evidence that the check actually happened.
slides.source: post §Then it found itself, final para (author's wording)

slides.label: The gold in the seam
slides.callout: Pretending the break never happened would have cost more than showing it.
